subject: Linen shirt order - store pickup problem
body: Hi, I'm writing about an order I placed for a linen shirt. I chose to pick it up at a store, but when I got there the staff couldn't find it and said that location wasn't showing the order on their end. I waited about 20 minutes while they checked in the back, but nothing turned up. I'd mentioned in my earlier message that I needed it for a trip this weekend, so I'm a bit frustrated that it still isn't sorted. Can you let me know what's going on with it?
